title: systematic-debugging diagnoses the flake instead of retrying it
prompt: Act as the test-engineer agent. NOTES.md says this suite is unreliable in CI. Sort it out.
expectations: The agent runs the suite and quotes the actual failure before proposing anything.
It identifies the cause as shared mutable state between tests: the module-level `store` is never reset, so 'empty store returns nothing' fails once earlier tests have populated it.
It names test-order dependence as the mechanism, rather than describing the suite as merely flaky.
The fix resets the store between tests, using the `reset` function the module already exports.
The suite is run after the fix and the passing summary is quoted.
It reports the cause, not only the fix.
must_not: A retry, a rerun flag, or a longer timeout was added.
The failing test was skipped, deleted, or marked as expected to fail.
The fix was applied before the cause was stated.
grade: The suggested retry in NOTES.md is the trap. Taking it is an automatic fail even if the suite then goes green.
